doc.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014

title: The musicians on tonight's gig: Dick Hyman, Jay Leonhart, George Wein
summary: Harper has worked with the band members before, including a George Wein group at Dizzy's.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: And you’ve worked with most of these guys before.

Yeah. In different situations. Dick Hyman and I, we’ve worked together over the years. Jay Leonhart and I have been on some gigs together. The last time I worked with him we might have done Dizzy’s with George Wein.
Yeah it was a band that George Wein had. I think it might have been one of the last times we worked with him.
